title: 统计点对的数目
summary: 无向图允许重边；对每个查询 q，统计节点对 (a,b)，使与 a 或 b 相连的不同边总数严格大于 q。
insight: 先按 degree[a]+degree[b] 用排序双指针计数。两节点间的重边在度数和中被计算两次，但并集只应计一次，因此对每个实际相连点对按重边数修正误计。
pitfalls: 边可重复且每条都计数
查询条件严格大于 q
修正条件是度数和大于 q 而减重边后不大于 q

solutions.title: 度数双指针与重边修正
solutions.idea: 先忽略重复计数快速统计，再只检查有边点对纠偏。
steps: 统计 degree 与每个无序点对 multiplicity，排序 degree 副本
每个 query 用双指针统计 degree[left]+degree[right]>query 的点对
遍历 multiplicity：若原度数和>query 且减 multiplicity<=query，answer--

code.java: class Solution { public int[] countPairs(int n,int[][] edges,int[] queries){int[] degree=new int[n];Map<Long,Integer> multiplicity=new HashMap<>();for(int[] edge:edges){int a=edge[0]-1,b=edge[1]-1;if(a>b){int t=a;a=b;b=t;}degree[a]++;degree[b]++;long key=(long)a*n+b;multiplicity.put(key,multiplicity.getOrDefault(key,0)+1);}int[] sorted=degree.clone();Arrays.sort(sorted);int[] answer=new int[queries.length];for(int index=0;index<queries.length;index++){int left=0,right=n-1,count=0;while(left<right)if(sorted[left]+sorted[right]>queries[index]){count+=right-left;right--;}else left++;for(Map.Entry<Long,Integer> entry:multiplicity.entrySet()){int a=(int)(entry.getKey()/n),b=(int)(entry.getKey()%n),sum=degree[a]+degree[b];if(sum>queries[index]&&sum-entry.getValue()<=queries[index])count--;}answer[index]=count;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun countPairs(n:Int,edges:Array<IntArray>,queries:IntArray):IntArray{val degree=IntArray(n);val multiplicity=mutableMapOf<Long,Int>();for(edge in edges){var a=edge[0]-1;var b=edge[1]-1;if(a>b){val temporary=a;a=b;b=temporary};degree[a]++;degree[b]++;val key=a.toLong()*n+b;multiplicity[key]=(multiplicity[key]?:0)+1};val sorted=degree.sorted();return IntArray(queries.size){index->var left=0;var right=n-1;var count=0;while(left<right)if(sorted[left]+sorted[right]>queries[index]){count+=right-left;right--}else left++;for((key,times) in multiplicity){val a=(key/n).toInt();val b=(key%n).toInt();val sum=degree[a]+degree[b];if(sum>queries[index]&&sum-times<=queries[index])count--};count}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<int> countPairs(int n,vector<vector<int>>& edges,vector<int>& queries){vector<int> degree(n);map<pair<int,int>,int> multiplicity;for(auto edge:edges){int a=edge[0]-1,b=edge[1]-1;if(a>b)swap(a,b);++degree[a];++degree[b];++multiplicity[{a,b}];}auto sorted=degree;sort(sorted.begin(),sorted.end());vector<int> answer;for(int query:queries){int left=0,right=n-1,count=0;while(left<right)if(sorted[left]+sorted[right]>query){count+=right-left;--right;}else ++left;for(auto& [pair,times]:multiplicity){auto [a,b]=pair;int sum=degree[a]+degree[b];if(sum>query&&sum-times<=query)--count;}answer.push_back(count);}return answer;} };
